description: The experiments compare direct user-equipment connection to a base station with an intermediate relay arrangement. The source identifies two USRP B210 devices, 5G end modules with custom SIM cards, srsRAN base stations and Open5GS core functions. iPerf3 and VLC generate traffic, including different streaming resolutions. The authors explicitly connect these observations to network-load evaluation and machine-learning resource orchestration. This is a distinct direct/relay collection from the later O-RAN VR/xApp deposit; experimental overlap remains unverified.
